claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening at a place printed as '$15 heres street', with the best of singers only engaged.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, $15 heres street. Free concert every evening.
places: $15 heres street, St. Louis (printed as; probably 619 Market street)

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world in a March 1891 advertisement.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, $15 heres street. Free concert every evening.

notes: The address is garbled in OCR ('$15 heres street'); other 1891 ads give 619 Market street, but the text itself does not say so. Rest of the page is unrelated sporting news.
